description: The work will consist of furnishing all labor, equipment, operators, supervision, supplies, materials, and incidentals necessary to supply and install the replacement Lock and Dam 24 Bulkhead Hoist /Service Crane. The installation work is anticipated to be accomplished with traditional river marine construction equipment such as floating plant, barge mounted crane, and additional support equipment as needed. --------- AMENDMENT 0001 to provide revised SOW, Appendix C and Government Responses to ProjNet Bidder Inquiries.***(Bid Abstract Notice)
